description: List this account's site shares (share_site_access): domain, who it is for, and `status`: PENDING (waiting for the account holder to approve), ACTIVE (approved, link not used yet), CLAIMED (the other person connected), REVOKED or EXPIRED. For an ACTIVE share it also returns `shareUrl`, the one thing to send the other person (it opens a page with a prompt for their AI assistant and the share code), plus `qrCodeUrl`, and `shareCode` and `handoffPrompt` in case you send the message yourself. Those are only returned to keys allowed to hand them out (full access or the `account` permission). Each share has an `id` for revoke_site_share.
name: list_site_shares
title: List Site Shares
